title: Transformer Research Publication
summary: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Lukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin submitted 'Attention Is All You Need' on June 12, 2017. The paper proposed the Transformer, a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention mechanisms rather than recurrent or convolutional sequence modeling.
significance: A documented architecture research milestone establishing the Transformer as an attention-based approach to sequence transduction and reporting machine-translation results plus an English constituency-parsing application.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the June 12, 2017 first-submission date, authors, Transformer name, attention-only architecture framing, machine-translation experiments, and constituency-parsing application. The official NeurIPS 2017 proceedings independently corroborate the paper title, authors, venue, and core architecture claim. This record uses the arXiv first-submission date strictly as a research-publication milestone. It does not infer an exact software-release date, product launch, API availability, institutional affiliation, geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationships.
